# `aitbc simulate blockchain`

Simulate blockchain block generation and transactions.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate blockchain [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--blocks` | integer | `10` | no | Number of blocks to simulate |
| `--transactions` | integer | `50` | no | Number of transactions per block |
| `--delay` | float | `1.0` | no | Delay between blocks (seconds) |
| `--output` | choice | `table` | no | Output format |
| `--seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic simulation (default: live) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate blockchain
aitbc simulate blockchain --output json
```
